title: moi public.json
description: The small, signed, explicitly-curated set of facets a user chooses to make public (SPEC 3.15). The only file moi advertises (SPEC 12). The serialized document MUST be <= 1024 bytes. `sig` is an Ed25519 signature, by `key`, over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization of this object with the `sig` member removed; `key` MUST match identity.pub (SPEC 3.14).

key.description: Base64 of the 32-byte Ed25519 public key of the signer; matches identity.pub.

facets.description: Open key->value map of public facets, in the spirit of avatar.txt's open keys. `nick` and `pronouns` are suggested; the rest is the user's. Values are a string or an array of strings.

ts.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp, with a timezone offset or Z. Lets readers prefer the freshest copy.

sig.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the JCS canonicalization of this document with `sig` removed.
